question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many orders have the status 'shipped'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='shipped'

question: List all the distinct product categories.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products

question: What is the average price of a product?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question: List the names of customers who live in Mumbai.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city='Mumbai'

question: What is the total revenue across all order items?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*p.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id

question: How many products are in the Electronics category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category='Electronics'

question: Which city has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the name of the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders did the customer named 'Aisha Khan' place?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.name='Aisha Khan'

question: List the product names in the Furniture category.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category='Furniture'

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

question: What is the total quantity of items ordered across all order items?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items

question: How many distinct customers have placed at least one order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders

question: How many products cost more than 1000?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price>1000

question: List the names of customers who signed up in March 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03%'

question: How many orders are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: List the three most expensive products by name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many customers are from Delhi or Bengaluru?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city IN ('Delhi','Bengaluru')

question: What is the price of the product named 'Office Chair'?
gold_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE name='Office Chair'

question: How many order items reference the product 'Wireless Mouse'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE p.name='Wireless Mouse'

question: Which customer placed the most orders? Give the customer name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
